reason: I'm home with the kids all week and there is basically nowhere indoors around Salisbury to go between naps, so a calm place where I can sit with coffee and Wi-Fi for a work email or two is genuinely useful. The free first visit and the cleaning log get me in the door.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler licks everything. A posted log is nice, but I'd want to see the toys really being wiped down when I'm there. And $15 each time adds up fast if I go weekly.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning actually happen on my free first visit. If it looked grubby I'd not come back, and a lower per-visit price or a pack that makes it about $10 would make me go more often.
